prior.case_context: New to the reviewed catalogue as an exact ordered Nb2HfTa geometry-route hypothesis. Known experimental HfNbTa has a different composition and is not an identity match. Published source predictions are acknowledged; worldwide first discovery is not claimed.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: NegativeGamma modes are predominantly translational, and the independently checked optical form is positive beyond raw printing bounds. Magnetism/SOC/disorder and full-BZ/finite-temperature stability remain beyond this nonmagnetic source approximation.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Zero-pressure-target optimized models and completed sampled non-Gamma/ASR-path phonons plus positive Gamma optical compression support local near-ambient harmonic feasibility within the declared source model.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Non-isometric species-resolved network differences accompany the same-composition source EPC contrast at ten common widths; different reciprocal grids remain an explicit numerical confound.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Matched reciprocal-resolution refinement must preserve A>B and optical positivity; reversal or adverse structural/magnetic evidence revises this screen. Source association or inconclusive refinement leaves the research hypothesis unresolved.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
